summary: Verified implementation of cost matrix features after bug fix. All 70 backend API tests pass (100%). Code review confirms all requested features are correctly implemented: service catalog loading, findServicePrice() function, Set Up and Recurring cost matrices with proper columns (N°, Concepto, Cajas, Bancos, Tarifa, Total), formula Total = Tarifa * Cajas * Bancos, Subtotal rows, editable Discount field, Total Neto calculations, and Grand Total in black footer.

service_catalog_loading.description: fetchData() loads /api/services along with clients, banks, quotes. Stored in serviceCatalog state.

findServicePrice_function.description: Searches catalog by product name (exact/partial match), returns setup_cost_conventional and monthly_cost_conventional

subtotal_calculation.description: Uses reduce() to sum all row totals

discount_field.description: Editable % field in footer, applies same discount to both matrices

grand_total.display: Black footer with white text, 2xl font
